Name: cost_sensitive_regularization
Title: Cost Sensitive Regularization for Fall Detection
Experiment: One way to address the data imbalance issue is to use class-sensitive costs. This involves assigning different costs to different types of misclassifications. For example, classifying fall events as normal activities could result in a disaster, while classifying normal activities as alert just gives false alarms. Cost-sensitive regularization combines the base loss with a cost-sensitive loss. We can experiment with different lambdas and observe their impact on model performance.
